mapper.sql: SELECT r.RequestId, r.UserId, r.ProposedPenName, r.Introduction, r.Status, r.ReviewNote, r.CreatedAt, r.ReviewedAt FROM dbo.AuthorRequest r
mapper.select: WHERE r.UserId = #{userId} ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC, r.RequestId DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Author WHERE PenName = #{penName}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.AuthorRequest SET Status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE RequestId = #{requestId} AND UserId = #{userId} AND Status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT Status FROM dbo.AuthorRequest WHERE RequestId = #{requestId}

SELECT r.RequestId, r.ProposedPenName, r.Status, r.CreatedAt, r.ReviewedAt, u.UserId AS Applicant_UserId, u.Username AS Applicant_Username, u.AvatarUrl AS Applicant_AvatarUrl, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuthorRequest r2 WHERE r2.UserId = r.UserId AND r2.Status = 'REJECTED' AND r2.RequestId <> r.RequestId ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PreviouslyRejected FROM dbo.AuthorRequest r JOIN dbo.[User] u ON u.UserId = r.UserId
ORDER BY r.CreatedAt ASC, r.RequestId ASC ORDER BY COALESCE(r.ReviewedAt, r.CreatedAt) DESC, r.RequestId DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT r.RequestId, r.ProposedPenName, r.Introduction, r.Status, r.ReviewNote, r.CreatedAt, r.ReviewedAt, u.UserId AS Applicant_UserId, u.Username AS Applicant_Username, u.Email AS Applicant_Email, u.AvatarUrl AS Applicant_AvatarUrl, u.Role AS Applicant_Role, u.Status AS Applicant_Status, u.CreatedAt AS Applicant_JoinedAt, rv.UserId AS Reviewer_UserId, rv.Username AS Reviewer_Username FROM dbo.AuthorRequest r JOIN dbo.[User] u ON u.UserId = r.UserId LEFT JOIN dbo.[User] rv ON rv.UserId = r.ReviewedBy WHERE r.RequestId = #{requestId}

SELECT o.Status, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM dbo.AuthorRequest o WHERE o.UserId = (SELECT r.UserId FROM dbo.AuthorRequest r WHERE r.RequestId = #{requestId}) AND o.RequestId <> #{requestId} GROUP BY o.Status
